name: AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-1
cards.audioText: Your call sign is AFR151. You are at Wuhan airport, at Gate 215, information G received, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是法航151，在武汉机场，215号机位，收到通播G，向ATC申请放行至巴黎。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR151, Gate 215, information G, destination Paris, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，法航151，215号机位，通播G，目的地巴黎，请求管制许可。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-2
cards.audioText: AFR151, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, runway 04, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10700m, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 2521.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往巴黎，LKO-01号离场，跑道04，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10700米，离场频率119.7，应答机2521。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, runway 04, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10700m, 119.7, squawk 2521, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至巴黎，LKO-01号离场，跑道04，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10700米，119.7，应答机2521，法航151。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-3
cards.audioText: You decide 10700m is not acceptable due to heavy weight. Ask whether 9500m is available.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于飞机过重，10700米不能接受。询问9500米是否可行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR151, negative 10700m due weight, confirm 9500m is available.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，法航151，由于重量，我们不能接受10700米，证实9500米可用。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-4
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，重新允许巡航高度9500米。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-5
cards.audioText: Now you are ready for pushback and start-up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR151, gate 215, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，法航151，215号停机位，请求推出开车。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-6
cards.audioText: AFR151, Ground, pushback and start-up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，地面，同意推出开车，头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, facing east, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，头朝东，法航151。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-7
cards.audioText: You are now on the taxiway Z4 with your engines running. Ask Ground Control for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在滑行道Z4上，发动机已经启动。向地面指挥询问滑行指令。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，法航151，请求滑行。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-8
cards.audioText: AFR151, taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A, hold short of A4.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，沿滑行道Z4，A滑至跑道04等待点，在A4外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A, hold short of A4, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A滑至跑道04等待点，在A4外等待，法航151。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-9
cards.audioText: AFR151, give way to the B737 vacating from E3, when the traffic cleared, continue taxi A, A9, hold short of runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，给正在从E3脱离的波音737让路，飞机没影响后，继续沿滑行道A，A9滑至跑道04外等待。
cards.referenceText: Give way to the B737, when the traffic cleared, continue taxi A, A9, hold short of runway 04, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给波音737让路，飞机没影响后，继续沿滑行道A，A9滑至跑道04外等待，法航151。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-10
cards.audioText: Now you are airborne at 600m climbing, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在飞机已起飞，600米爬升，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，法航151起飞，通过600米。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-11
cards.audioText: AFR 151, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000m on QNH 1015.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉离场，雷达已识别，左转直飞DA，上升保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1015。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000m on QNH 1015, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，上升保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1015，法航151。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-12
cards.audioText: AFR151, continue climb and maintain 6000m on standard, expedite passing 3900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，继续上升保持标压6000米，快速通过3900米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 6000m on standard, expedite passing 3900m, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持标压6000米，快速通过3900米，法航151。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-13
cards.audioText: You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6000m, request higher level and state the reason to Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持6000米时，你遇到了中度积冰，请求更高的飞行高度，并向武汉区调陈述原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR151, maintaining 6000m, request higher level due moderate icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航151，保持6000米，由于中度积冰，申请高高度。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-14
cards.audioText: AFR 151, Wuhan Control, negative due traffic, maintain 6000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉区调，高度没位置，保持6000米。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-15
cards.audioText: Suddenly your left engine failed at 6000m, make an urgency call ATC, and request descent and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 在6000米处左侧发动机突然失效，紧急呼叫ATC，请求下降并返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR151, maintaining 6000m, left engine failure, request descent and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，法航151，保持6000米，左侧发动机失效，请求下降并返回武汉机场。

cards.taskTitle: 19. AFR151 · 积冰与发动机失效-16
cards.audioText: AFR 151, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, descend and maintain 4200m, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for runway 04.[You successfully restart the left engine, decide to return to Wuhan. Inform ATC and cancel urgency.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉区调，收到PANPAN，下降保持4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导跑道04。【你成功地重启了左侧发动机，决定返回武汉，通知ATC取消紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 4200m, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for runway 04, cancel PANPAN, we have successfully restarted the left engine, request return to Wuhan airport, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导跑道04，取消PANPAN，我们成功地重启了左侧发动机，请求返回武汉机场，法航151。
